messages.author: d718c6bb1db28db2
messages.subject: Re: Components of Var D
parts:
On Sun, 4 Jun 2000, St. Katherine Protectorate wrote:

> > Dear Fellows
> >
> > I have a question I failed to answer. In the results of a distance sampling analysis, section (Density estimates/Global) I have percentages of components of VarD. My question is :
> > In a good survey design & practice, which component would contribute to Vard D ( detection probability or Encounter Rate)?
> > Please kindly advice

Husam, both contribute, but generally, encounter rate contributes more -
typically perhaps 60% to 75% of the variance. If objects are very
clustered, it may account for more than 75% of the variance. If objects
are very evenly distributed, you might find that estimation of the
detection function contributes most of the variation.

Steve
